blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Philippines’ Eleaphraime Limmong’s Asian Games 2026 stint ended with a did-not-finish result after he failed all three of his snatch attempts in the men’s 60-kilogram weightlifting final Thursday at Nagoya City Trade and Industry Center. The 21-year-0ld Limmong attempted 120 kilograms three times but ended his campaign without a completed lift. Sri Lankan weightlifter S. Wiriduwalage Kaluwa Ran Supun Dilhara Somathilaka also had a DNF after failing all three of his clean and jerk attempts. He completed 106 in snatch. China’s Yang Yang won gold with […]...
